name: Suno V6 Wild
description: Suno V6 Wild is Suno's exploratory v6 music model. Suno describes it as less predictable and more varied, producing unexpected, textured, and ambitious results, and makes it available to Pro and Premier subscribers.

details.name: availability
details.value: Available to Pro and Premier subscribers.

details.name: generation_style
details.value: Built for exploration, with less predictable and more varied results.

details.name: pricing
details.value: The announcement does not publish an API price or per-generation credit rate.

page_notice.markdown: Suno V6 Wild is a consumer product release for Pro and Premier subscribers. Suno has not published an official API model ID or API pricing in this announcement, so no Phaseo API route is asserted.

sources.notes: Official announcement dated September 9, 2026 names v6-wild, describes its exploratory role and Pro/Premier availability, and lists text, audio, image, and video creation across the v6 models.

verification.notes: Official product name, release date, subscriber availability, and product modalities verified. API model ID, API route, and API pricing remain unpublished.
